name: Björkvik and Björnö sheltered sampler
estimatedTime: 2 hours to day or overnight variants
description: Self-service route area from Björkviks Havsbad around Björnö, Torpesand and nearby sheltered bays, with longer overnight-capable options for experienced paddlers.

safety.exposure: Sheltered bays nearby; exposure increases when extending south/east.
windWeatherNotes: Self-service users need to self-assess weather and route.

campingRules: Overnight variants need Björnö/reserve rule check.

protectionRules.summary: Björkvik/Björnö area is a nature-reserve/visitor-area route; use established beaches/launches and verify fire/camping rules before any overnight extension.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Do not assume camping/fire permission until exact reserve rules are attached.
